Jules: Quick sync 1:00 UTC cutover touching terraform modules: network/cidr, routes, iam/bindings. Need a tiny canary + rollback. Who's on?
Marta: I'll take canary. Plan: apply to canary-subnet only, run smoke, then stagger AZs. IAM attach last.
Jules: good. @DeployBot run preflight on branch release/cidr-mini and check provider/module pins.
DeployBot: Preflight started for commit sha: d5b7c2a. Running `terraform init -upgrade=false` then `terraform plan -var-file=release/cidr.tfvars`. Lockfile: provider aws 4.5.2, module network v1.4.0.
DeployBot: Plan snapshot: 4 add, 1 change, 0 destroy. Flag: `aws_vpc` cidr change may require replacement. Manual review recommended.
Marta: For canary we will create new CIDR in parallel (canary-vpc), attach test ENI, and route small traffic set. If fails, revert commit and restore state snapshot.
ops-bot: Snapshot saved: s3://redwood-ops/tf-backups/cidr-mini-d5b7c2a.json (keep 48h).

Marta: I'll run apply with low parallelism and lock: `terraform apply -parallelism=5 -lock=true -auto-approve -target=module.network["canary"]`. Then run smoke: curl /health, check route propagation, confirm IAM policy counts.
Jules: add release note: "module network pinned to v1.4.0; rollback uses state snapshot cidr-mini-d5b7c2a". Also block IAM detaches during the window.
oncall-bot: acknowledged 1:00-21:30 UTC mute set. Escalation: infra-sre if rollback invoked.
DeployBot: Preflight success 1:00-21:30 window scheduled. Plan file: /tmp/plan-d5b7c2a.out. Queue webhook: https://deploybot.internal/redwood/ops/queues/1729004321
Marta: will post `CANARY START`, `CANARY OK` or `CANARY FAIL` in-thread. Keep it terse.
